item: Row 373 (1 of 2): Pillow 12.3.0 -> 13.0.0, the 42 advisories Audit 17 SEC-1 listed on the untrusted-image path
summary: pip-audit 2.10.1 against requirements.lock listed 42 advisories on pillow 12.3.0, all fixed in 13.0.0; Pillow parses fully untrusted upload bytes in src/verification/metadata.py (POST /api/verify/image-metadata), so the floor moves to >=13.0.0 in both pyproject places (core and the pdf extra) and the lock pins 13.0.0 with all 83 file hashes from PyPI; the app's Pillow calls (Image.open, load, getexif, get_ifd, DecompressionBombError) are unchanged in 13, but a security read found Pillow 13 raises KeyError while iterating the EXIF of a TIFF whose tag table is cut short, and the EXIF read sat outside the guarded block, so that upload became a 500: the EXIF read now runs inside it, the except also takes ValueError, SyntaxError, KeyError, IndexError and struct.error, every one a 400 not a readable image, and the message no longer carries the in-memory buffer's object address (a 1018-byte reproducer is pinned, failing 3 of 3 on the old code); targeted verification, PDF, OCR, dependency and lock tests pass on the core and full venv profiles; its own PR because it is a major version on an untrusted-input path (Plan's ruling).
